change: Bounded slice collection reuses collectOwnedRows and detaches selected borrowed payload before producer advance or closure.
evidence: Six offset/limit cases cover empty batches, zero count, cross-batch selection, exact end and offset beyond input.
Nested byte values survive scanner mutation and closure; unsupported lookahead payload is not copied.
Exact measured peak succeeds; cap-minus-one fails without releasing sibling reservation.
Partial and previous copied chunks release before delayed producer cleanup; cancellation releases prior chunks.
Real Parquet fixture spans 16 row groups and 128 text-bearing rows; pagination crosses row groups and preserves the first result after resumption.
48 KiB pool rejects oversized slice collection and recovers with a two-row slice.
Twelve real HTTP cases include 206 ranges, ignored-range 200 bodies, borrowed/native scanner capabilities, 64/128 MiB pools and cache eviction.
boundaries: Plain completed slice results transfer to caller management, matching toArray; the API does not retain charges after return.
Bookmark creation metadata and explicitly owned public slice results remain under review.
Selected values use the existing detachable scanner-data contract; cycles, accessors and unsupported custom prototypes reject.
Native Worker suite is regression evidence; newly added slice-specific fixture coverage is local-memory Parquet and local HTTP, not live cloud or native R2 slice coverage.
Full audit and final release gate refresh remain open.
